verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents its own REST API (deployments, assistant, analytics), but no evidence shows it publishes a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for that API, and probes of the common spec paths all returned 404. Its OpenAPI support is about rendering customers' specs into docs, which is a different capability and earns no credit here. The llms.txt endpoint descriptions are not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
